summary.text: Carlton Bowen is the Independent American Party of Utah nominee for Utah's 2nd Congressional District. An Air Force veteran, he works as a senior IT project manager at Intermountain Healthcare, previously served on the American Fork City Council and was the party's 2024 U.S. Senate nominee. He says he is running to defend constitutional freedoms.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Utah; graduated from Hillcrest High School.
Served in the U.S. Air Force from 1988 to 1994; earned an associate degree in imagery and intelligence analysis from the Community College of the Air Force.
Earned a bachelor's degree in economics from Weber State University and, according to his survey, graduated cum laude.
Works as a senior IT project manager at Intermountain Healthcare; has also worked as a program manager, instructor, consultant and team lead.
Served on the American Fork, Utah city council; he describes himself as a former council member.

Won the Independent American Party of Utah convention on April 27, 2024 and appeared on the November 2024 ballot for U.S. Senate, which John Curtis won; Bowen says he received 83,972 votes statewide and took part in the Utah Debate Commission's three-way Senate debate.
Describes himself as State Chair of the Independent American Party of Utah.
Says he married his wife, Linda, 38 years ago, and that they raised six children in Utah and have sixteen grandchildren.
